run.name: Qnity Electronics, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (Q)
run.summary: Qnity has a moderate-leverage, well-funded credit profile: total debt is 2.37x LTM Adjusted Operating EBITDA and liquidity is 2,362. Cancellable, concentrated demand and cash costs outside adjusted EBITDA are the main weaknesses. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt as stated at September 30, 2026 over FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025 Adjusted Operating EBITDA. Carrying value net of unamortized discount; principal would give a higher ratio. Excludes indirect legacy costs and transformation charges.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash at September 30, 2026 (Q3 p:5), of which 785 is held by foreign subsidiaries (Q3 p:41). Revolver 1,250 less 12 of letters of credit (Q3 p:20), no drawings. Uncommitted lines (136 unused) excluded.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant terms, the reported covenant ratio, 2026 cash interest and the executed debt documents are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted Operating EBITDA is a company measure; covenant EBITDA, the reported covenant ratio and 2026 cash interest are not supplied.
